problem_statement: codewithsadee/portfolio is a static personal portfolio for Ethan Ward (plain HTML/CSS/JS, served directly from files) with a fixed header + mobile nav toggle, a hero, an about section, a portfolio gallery of four image-backed project cards (Youtube, Vimeo, Soundcloud, Details), a skills section, a 'Drop Me a Line' contact card, a 'Checkout My Recent Blogs' section, and a footer. Above the four project cards in the #portfolio section sits a native 'work browser' (heading 'Browse work by discipline') whose discipline tabs (All / Product / Audio / Editorial) filter the project grid and update a live result readout ('Showing N of 4 · <discipline>'); the same work browser also rides above the grid on two secondary routes (work.html 'Selected Work' and about.html). The work browser is styled by assets/css/work-browser.css and wired by assets/js/work-browser.js. Four regressions must be repaired together: (1) on a 390px phone the discipline tab row is a fixed-width, non-wrapping row that pushes the whole one-page portfolio wider than the viewport, adding a horizontal scrollbar; (2) the filtered project grid is visually broken — the four cards are forced into one non-wrapping row with negative margins so they shingle over each other and clip off the right edge, and the active discipline tab is dark-on-dark and illegible; (3) the work browser only renders on the home route, so the /work.html and /about.html routes lose the discipline filter entirely; (4) clicking a discipline tab visibly highlights it but the grid never re-filters and the readout stays frozen on 'Showing all 4 projects' instead of updating to the selected discipline. Repair the work browser so the tab row is responsive (no mobile overflow), the grid and active tab are legible and un-clipped, the browser is present across the home, work, and about routes, and clicking a discipline live-filters the grid and updates the readout to 'Showing N of 4 · <discipline>'. Keep the four project cards, their images and category labels, the hero/about/skills/contact/blog sections, the header nav, and the dark space-cadet / orange-soda visual system unchanged.
required_content: The work browser keeps its 'Browse work by discipline' heading and its four discipline tabs (All, Product, Audio, Editorial) above the four project cards.
The one-page portfolio no longer overflows horizontally at 390px: the discipline tab row wraps or shrinks so the document width equals the phone viewport width.
The filtered project grid renders the four cards cleanly (no shingling, overlap, or clipping) and the active discipline tab is legible on desktop and tablet.
The work browser (discipline tabs + readout) appears on the home route AND on the work.html and about.html routes; it is not home-only.

Clicking a discipline tab live-filters the project grid and updates the readout to 'Showing N of 4 · <discipline>' (e.g. 'Showing 2 of 4 · Product'); it does not stay frozen on 'Showing all 4 projects'.
No JavaScript console errors or failed network requests are introduced on any captured state.
design_constraints: Preserve the dark portfolio visual system: space-cadet background, orange-soda accent, Barlow headings, rounded cards, and the four image-backed project tiles.

The work browser must remain a compact discipline filter that rides above the four project cards; do not redesign it into a hero, banner, or carousel, and do not replace the project images with plain text cards.
The discipline tab row must become responsive (wrap onto multiple rows and/or use a flexible tab basis) rather than relying on a fixed pixel row width with non-wrapping fixed-width tabs.
Do not mask the mobile overflow by clipping the row with overflow-x:hidden or shrinking the row width while keeping tabs from wrapping; the document itself must not exceed the mobile viewport.
The filter must actually change the visible result set: the discipline tabs re-derive both the shown cards and the count readout on every click, so the readout always matches the cards shown.

The work browser markup, styling (assets/css/work-browser.css), and wiring (assets/js/work-browser.js) are the only files that change between the broken and repaired site; index.html/work.html/about.html body content, assets/css/style.css, and the other sections stay the same.
state_constraints: desktop_initial and desktop_home_browser capture the one-page portfolio at 1440px: the work browser renders its four discipline tabs in a tidy single row above the four project cards with no horizontal overflow, and the grid is clean.

mobile_initial and mobile_home_browser capture the same page at 390px, where the broken fixed-width nowrap tab row pushes the document wider than the viewport; the repaired browser removes that overflow.

desktop_filter_product clicks the 'Product' discipline tab: the repaired grid filters to the two Product cards and the readout reads 'Showing 2 of 4 · Product'; the broken wiring leaves the grid on all four cards and the readout frozen on 'Showing all 4 projects'.
desktop_work and desktop_about capture the work.html and about.html routes, where the work browser must also appear above the grid; the broken site renders the browser only on home.
mobile_nav_open opens the mobile header menu at 390px; the header toggle continues to work regardless of the work-browser repair.

Source inspection confirms the site is a static HTML/CSS/JS portfolio served directly, the work browser markup lives inline in the page HTML, and only assets/css/work-browser.css and assets/js/work-browser.js control the browser's layout and filter behavior.

change_completion: The mobile page no longer overflows horizontally: document width equals the 390px viewport within tolerance.
Clicking a discipline tab live-filters the grid and updates the readout to 'Showing N of 4 · <discipline>' rather than staying frozen.
The work browser appears across the home, work, and about routes.
design_consistency: The browser keeps the space-cadet / orange-soda palette, rounded Barlow-headed panel, and compact discipline-filter proportions.
Desktop and tablet appearance of the browser and the four project cards is preserved.
The page remains the dark one-page portfolio, not a redesigned layout.
regression: The project cards, header nav, mobile menu toggle, hero/about imagery, skills, contact card, blog cards, back-to-top link, and footer remain functional and reachable.
No console errors or failed requests are introduced on any captured state, and no dependency, remote asset, or new build step is added.
responsive: 390px page has no horizontal overflow, tab collisions, or clipped tabs.
The discipline tab row wraps or shrinks cleanly on mobile while staying single-row on desktop/tablet.

author_notes: Repo-grounded static HTML/CSS/JS portfolio (Ethan Ward). capability=Repair on a native work-browser discipline filter over the project grid. The files that differ between the broken and repaired site are assets/css/work-browser.css (tab-row + grid layout) and assets/js/work-browser.js (filter wiring), plus the per-route presence of the work-browser panel on work.html / about.html. Content and DOM of the four portfolio-N.jpg project cards are preserved across legs. Four orthogonal discriminators: no_horizontal_overflow (tolerance 24) on the mobile home states (reference 0px, broken ~535-565px); visual_regression on the desktop and mobile browser states plus the filtered grid state (the broken grid shingles/clips the cards and the active tab is illegible); dom_assertions for the work-browser tabs across the work/about routes; and interaction_assertions for the discipline click updating the readout to 'Showing 2 of 4 · Product'. The offline vendoring of Google Fonts / ionicons and flipping body{overflow-x} to visible so the overflow is observable are declared infrastructure, identical across all three legs. Served directly as static files; reference is runtime-clean (0 console, 0 network, 0 overflow) across all nine captured states.
